method: Manual transcription of explicitly printed scalar values from the archived official UNL bitstream, followed by deterministic unit normalization

review.method: Second-pass comparison of every committed scalar against the cited page and paragraph

rounding_policy: Preserve every digit printed by the source; unit conversions are exact decimal shifts; explicit conversion uncertainty covers source rounding.
uncertainty_interpretation: Independent standard uncertainty components; engineering tolerance is preregistered separately and never used to fit the candidate.
